verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. A keeps the full headline inside the dark forest block, but "Joint celebration" is clipped at the block edge. The "March 21" date is cream on white and invisible, the divider lines are invisible, and the supporting copy and URL are missing. B clips the first line of the headline ("Special" is cut off at the top), runs the headline over the pale sky band so contrast is poor, and puts the date on white where it is nearly invisible. B also drops the subhead, body and URL, and is mostly empty white. A is slightly less bad because its headline is complete and readable.
